articles.headline: Austin Hill wins Hard Rock Bet 300 (Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Austin Hill won Hard Rock Bet 300 (Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P2 and leading 62 laps. Sammy Smith finished second and Brent Crews was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 4 cautions.

Gio Ruggiero was the biggest mover, gaining 15 spots from P22 to P7.

Austin Hill leads the championship with 1148 points, 13 ahead of Sam Mayer.
